dimensions.evidenceA: Priests buy it with returned silver.
dimensions.evidenceB: Judas is said to obtain it with the reward.
dimensions.label: Field acquisition

evidence.observation: Judas returns the silver and hangs himself; the priests use the money to buy the potter’s field.
Judas obtains a field with the reward and, falling headlong, bursts open.

record.tension: Death, acquisition action, and the field’s naming are narrated differently.
record.title: How does Judas die, and who acquires the field?
